report:
Initial stage: Two focal accounts explicitly narrate completed Experiment buying: A04 describes four product acquisition categories; A05 describes one checkout category. Total product_action_assertions = 5. These are account-level narrated categories, not verified transactions, units or independently established event counts. No second-stage evidence was supplied, so a between-stage comparison is unavailable.

A04 reports buying Super Saturated after a sister’s introduction and favorable experience, Buffer Jelly for greater nighttime hydration/repair, face wash after satisfaction with Buffer Jelly, and mesh moisturizer immediately upon release. A05 reports instantly checking out Avant Guard after TikTok discovery, in the context of wanting reusable masking compatible with sustainability goals. Together, two credited retailer-review origins repeat the broad proposition of completed Experiment buying; their specific motivations differ and are individually supported self-attributions, not independently repeated reasons or established causes. There is no focal cross-role corroboration of completed Experiment buying.

A01 explicitly attributes returning Experiment balm to an FF cart to another commenter’s recommendation; context identifies Softwear. Checkout, receipt and use remain unreported. A02’s disliked, skipped product and favored baste balm concern Dr. Idriss in parent context, not an adverse Experiment experience. A12’s cream 2.0 and cleanser acquisitions concern Regimen Lab; trying more is intention, and the cleanser’s small size coexists with enthusiasm. Neither supports Experiment acquisition.

A04 reports hydration without a clogged-pore feeling, pre-makeup suitability, glow after Buffer Jelly, and makeup removal, hydration and no more breakouts with the face wash. Its claim that separate makeup remover is no longer needed supports functional routine replacement; it does not explicitly document stopping a named remover. A05 reports imperfect cheek/nose fit alongside satisfaction, easy cleaning and continued routine use. Barrier improvement is attributed to hydrating/moisturizing products used in that routine, so the mask’s separate contribution is unresolved. No focal account explicitly reports Experiment stockpiling, gifted receipt, contemplated/completed return, or prospective routine substitution. These absences are bounded to this evidence set; no repurchase is established merely by A04’s refill metadata.

Material context, outside focal counts: cowrunamuck’s Softwear account (context_5f002acbf9eb1cd7bfc3; Reddit, September 5, 2025; score 21) reports two backups because of affection for the balm and formerly harder access, smooth/moisturized lips despite sensitivity elsewhere, and preference over Eadem because of scent/taste. This supports that actor’s backup holding and reported reasons, not A01’s purchase or experience. RowanVC (context_ff821dc553240c0290fa; same Reddit thread/date; score 42) praises Softwear and Experiment generally, but the embarrassing balm stash is not explicitly Experiment stock. RowanVC separately reports Dr. Idriss tackiness and layering with lanolin or another mask, with soft lips afterward. These are distinct visible contextual actors sharing one thread; they are not focal acquisition accounts. The Regimen Lab post resolves A12’s brand reference without donating product experience. Product-page and native-review metadata resolve A04/A05 scope, not additional purchases or people.

Raw engagement: A01 score 13, A02 score 4, A12 score 12; all supplied as material_positive=false and not_interpreted, with engagement observation times unavailable. A04 has 0 up/0 down votes observed March 23, 2025; A05 has 0/0 observed November 3, 2022. Context scores 21 and 42 lack engagement observation times and sufficient exposure context to assign material resonance. These metrics establish neither independent experiences nor buying effects. No bare agreeing reply independently corroborates checkout. Conflict posture for the narrow focal completed-buying proposition is none_observed; satisfaction remains qualified by A05’s fit complaint. Formula versions are unavailable except A12’s other-brand cream 2.0; product mappings and causal limits remain source-specific.

source_index.findings: Reddit boxybrown84, September 5, 2025; id reddit:1n9da6u:ncm3hhd. Explicitly removed then restored Experiment balm to an FF cart because of a commenter’s recommendation. Parent context identifies Softwear; version unknown. One cart readdition, no narrated acquisition/use. Score 13, material_positive=false, observation time unavailable. Parent cowrunamuck’s two backups and favorable experience belong to that separate contextual actor; shared-thread recommendation influence is a single-actor self-attribution.

Reddit PamelaDamnela, September 5, 2025; id reddit:1n9da6u:ncly8vq. Owns but routinely skips 'that one' because of its feel and loves the baste balm. Parent context resolves these to Dr. Idriss exfoliator/Barrier Baste, not Experiment; precise SKU/version unknown. No Experiment buying, return or substitution narrated. Score 4, material_positive=false, observation time unavailable. RowanVC’s parent reports layering and praises Softwear separately; those experiences cannot be assigned to A02.

Junip customer 202931541, March 22, 2025; review 7540631; credited origin. Four explicit Experiment acquisition categories: Super Saturated after sister-led introduction and favorable experience; Buffer Jelly for more nighttime hydration/repair; face wash after Buffer Jelly satisfaction; mesh moisturizer immediately at launch. Face wash and mesh likely map to Plasma Wash/Molecular Mesh, but body does not give full names; versions unknown. Reports lightweight, fast-drying, non-clogging hydration before makeup; tiny-amount Buffer Jelly use and morning glow; face-wash hydration, no more breakouts and no separate makeup remover needed. Counted as functional completed routine replacement, not proof of disposal or cessation of a named remover. Likes colorful packaging; its purchase influence is not isolated. Metadata says combo+sensitive, verified buyer, unrewarded, Super Saturated Refill; does not add a repurchase assertion. Votes 0 up/0 down observed March 23, 2025. Detailed single-origin sequence and reasons, no independent corroboration of its individual outcomes.

Junip customer 44968672, November 3, 2022; review 1569510; credited origin. Explicit instant checkout of reusable Avant Guard after TikTok discovery, against a stated sustainability motive and previous near-nightly disposable masking. One acquisition category. Reports use, easy cleaning and imperfect cheek/nose fit alongside satisfaction; mask motivates use of other hydrating/moisturizing products helping the barrier, leaving joint-use attribution unresolved. No gift, return or explicit replacement of an active routine product. Metadata identifies Acid Lime/SMALL, verified buyer and unrewarded; formula/version unknown. Votes 0 up/0 down observed November 3, 2022. Specific buying reason and fit complaint remain single-origin observations.

Reddit eratch, January 16, 2025; id reddit:1i30kik:m7j6no0. Thread context identifies Regimen Lab, not Experiment. Reports getting cream 2.0 while seeking a healing moisturizer after excessive tret use, and acquiring its cleanser. Favorable cream experience prompts intention to try more; cleanser is nice but small, with greater interest in serums/moisturizers. No Experiment acquisition, completed future buying, return or explicit routine substitution. Cleanser SKU/version unknown. Score 12, material_positive=false, observation time unavailable; independence posture unavailable.
